name: Frostearrific
bio: Frostearrific is an admin on Silver Springs Survival, otherwise known as Frosty. She is a laid back staffer often using dead memes and frequently farting. Extremely fond of farming, she is often called the Farming Queen or Farming Maniac. Frosty also goes by the nicknames Frooty, Fronky, or Frothy. She is a lover of sheep, poros, and all things floofy.
history: Frostearrific first became a Moderator October 12th of 2014 (along with Autumn Bun) and first became an Admin in November of 2014.
